resources.string: Reads the structure of the screen in the apps you choose, to find ads and cover them with a message. Nothing is stored or sent: the app has no Internet access.
Three steps to put the glasses on
Android 13 and later: open App info, then menu ⋮ → Allow restricted settings. Without this, Android greys out the service of apps installed outside a store.
Open the accessibility settings and turn on Truth Glasses.
Add the Glasses tile to Quick Settings, to switch them on and off at any time.
Pull down Quick Settings, tap the pencil and drag the Glasses tile in, to switch them on and off at any time.
Red outline around detected labels, blue around covered blocks, screen tree in the logs (adb logcat -s TG).
No Internet connection. Nothing is stored or sent.
